visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four women are standing in a modern bathroom, arranged in a row in front of a dark marble wall. The woman on the far left wears a purple bikini and a white cat-ear headband. Next to her, a woman in a red one-piece swimsuit wears a small yellow crown. The third woman is in a black bikini, and the woman on the far right wears an orange bikini. They begin a synchronized dance, performing rhythmic hand-claps and waving their arms above their heads with cheerful facial expressions. In the foreground, a bathtub is filled with white soap bubbles. (2) The dancers transition their movements, shifting their weight and pointing their hands forward in unison. They then turn to their right, lining up one behind the other and placing their hands on the waist of the person in front. They continue to smile brightly while swaying their bodies to the rhythm. Through the large window behind them, a city skyline with distant lights is visible at night, illuminated by bright indoor ceiling lights that reflect off the polished marble surfaces.
